title: Feature start seeds every gate as pending, and bee gate records who approved and why
action: Make a run enter awaiting-approval on its own, and make an approval say who and why (per D1, D2, D3). Two halves. FIRST: `bee state start-feature` must seed every gate on the new record with state "pending" instead of a bare approved:false — the attachment points are the default_gates() calls in state_group/policy.rs near lines 390 and 506. After this, starting a feature is what puts the run into awaiting-approval; nobody types it. SECOND: `bee state gate` gains three optional flags — --actor ("user" or "auto", defaulting to "user"), --bypass-level (one of off, normal, full, total), and --reason (free text) — and writes them onto the entry with the current timestamp. The flag allowlist to extend is in run_gate_body in state_group/set_gate.rs (search for the accepted-flags list containing "name", "merge", "approved", "lane", "no-lane", "owner", near line 549); the write itself is near line 700-710. --approved false continues to stamp gate_revoked_at exactly as today (search set_gate.rs for `gate_revoked_at`, near line 690) and additionally sets state "rejected". Per D2 an auto-approval is REQUIRED to carry --actor auto plus --bypass-level and --reason: refuse an --actor auto call that omits either, so a bypassed run can never be less traceable than a stopped one. If the CLI help or registry payload is generated from a declaration rather than hand-written, regenerate it in the same cell so the shipped surface matches.

truths: bee state start-feature leaves every gate on the new record with state pending
bee gate --approved true --actor user records state approved, actor user, and a timestamp
bee gate --approved true --actor auto --bypass-level normal --reason X records all three on the entry
bee gate --actor auto without --bypass-level or without --reason refuses and writes nothing
bee gate --approved false still stamps gate_revoked_at and sets state rejected

artifacts.substantive: three new flags parsed, validated, and written; auto-actor precondition enforced
tests for pending seeding, each actor path, the auto-without-level refusal, and the revocation path

key_links: start-feature's default_gates path produces entries carrying state pending
run_gate_body's flag allowlist accepts actor, bypass-level, and reason
prohibitions: No change to the merged --merge semantics of flipping shape and execution together
No change to gate_revoked_at's existing stamping behavior
No agent-side self-approval logic — the flags record a decision, they never make one
